title: Method for the Kinematic Analysis of the Four-Bar Mechanisms Used in Car Wheel Suspension Systems
content: This paper deals with an analytical method for the kinematic analysis of the four-bar (also called double-wishbone, or SLA – Short-Long Arm) mechanisms used in car wheel suspension systems. While in other methods found in the literature, the problem of kinematic analysis of the mechanisms in question is translated into systems of nonlinear equations, the solution of which requires appropriate numerical methods, the method proposed here generates a sequence of systems of linear equations that are relatively easy to solve. Furthermore, the proposed method does not require the establishment of an initial solution, on whose accuracy the speed of convergence would subsequently depend, as is the case with methods based on nonlinear systems. The chosen independent kinematic parameter is the linear stroke of the damper (the relative displacement between the two parts of the damper, piston and cylinder), but this choice does not constitute an impediment in terms of correspondence with the actual cause of the wheel’s vertical motion (road surface irregularities), as the correlation between these displacements is easily established. Based on the proposed method, a computation program was developed using the MATLAB programming language. Finally, a numerical application for an existing front wheel suspension mechanism is presented.
